name: cs-navigator
description: Find the smallest evidence-backed ChatGPT Skills set for a user's goal.

interface.shortDescription: Find the smallest evidence-backed skill set
interface.longDescription: Describe what you want to accomplish and CS Navigator recommends the smallest useful skill set while keeping execution mode, evidence, setup, and known gaps visible.
defaultPrompt: Use CS Navigator to find the smallest useful skill set for what I want to accomplish.
Use CS Navigator to tell me whether this task needs a skill at all.
